analysis.reasonEn: RSI exited oversold, now holding neutral. MACD histogram improving from negative but still weak. Volume ratio at 0.44, indicating contraction. Price at 18.5% of 52-week range, attempting rebound but weak trend signals. Maintaining wait-and-see for 15 consecutive sessions.
